name: watch_party
description: Repo-root tooling only. The app lives in app/ (server + React client) and flutter_app/ (desktop client), each with its own package.json and test suite; this manifest exists to carry the dependencies of scripts/party-smoke.mjs. There is deliberately no root `test` script — `cd app && npm test`, `cd app/client && npm test`, `cd flutter_app && flutter test`.
